description: Delete a saved blueprint from the local store. Safe to call directly: the first call changes nothing and returns a preview plus a confirm_token; repeating the call with the token deletes it. Servers built from it are untouched.

confirm_token.description: The token from this exact action's preview. Where the app can show a confirmation dialog, calling with it asks the user there, and it happens only if they agree.

dry_run.description: If true, nothing is changed: the result shows what this call would do.

name: delete_blueprint
title: Delete blueprint
